title: Unemployment Insurance Appeals Bench Card: Postponement and Evidence Deadlines
content:
**Unemployment Insurance Appeals — deadlines before a hearing, by docket.** The figures below fix, for each docket: the business days before the hearing by which a non-emergency postponement must be requested; the number of postponements one party may receive on one appeal; the calendar days after a granted postponement within which the hearing is reset; the business days before the hearing by which documentary exhibits must be received; and the business days before the hearing by which a subpoena must be requested. Where a figure is 0 the docket holds no hearing.

| Docket | Postponement request lead (business days) | Postponements per party per appeal | Reset window after a granted postponement (calendar days) | Exhibit deadline (business days before the hearing) | Subpoena request lead (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lower Authority Appeal — Separation Issue | 3 | 1 | 14 | 2 | 5 |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Able and Available Issue | 3 | 1 | 14 | 2 | 5 |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Monetary Determination | 3 | 1 | 14 | 2 | 5 |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Overpayment and Fraud | 3 | 1 | 14 | 2 | 5 |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Benefit Charge | 3 | 1 | 21 | 2 | 5 |
| Lower Authority Appeal — Employer Contribution Rate | 3 | 1 | 21 | 2 | 5 |
| Higher Authority Appeal — Board of Review | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Terms common to every docket

| Term | All seven dockets |
|---|---|
| A documented emergency allows a postponement requested later than the lead | yes |
| Treatment of an exhibit received after the exhibit deadline | admitted only with good cause |

## Points of judgement

- Every lower-authority docket shares the same leads: 3 business days for a postponement request, 2 business days for exhibits, 5 business days for a subpoena request, and 1 postponement per party.
- The reset window is 14 calendar days on the Separation Issue, Able and Available Issue, Monetary Determination and Overpayment and Fraud dockets and 21 calendar days on the two employer dockets.
- The Board of Review holds no hearing, so every figure in its row is 0.
